update_consolidated_keyframe: merge an incremental keyframe into a consolidated keyframe by appending loads, creations, and updating state, metadata, and rig entries
update_consolidated_message: consolidate a single user message by merging UI updates per canvas and overwriting other message fields
update_consolidated_messages: consolidate a list of messages on a per-user basis by calling update_consolidated_message for each user index
get_user_keyframe: create a new keyframe with a user-specific message dict attached as the message key from a KeyframeAndMessages object
get_empty_keyframe: create an empty keyframe dictionary with initialized lists for loads, creations, stateUpdates, metadata, rigUpdates, and deletions
